adsense.about: Paste your AdSense publisher ID (ca-pub-...) after Google approves the site. Slot ids come from AdSense > Ads > By ad unit. Empty = that ad spot is not shown.

gemini.about: Free Google Gemini settings. models: tried in order (each has its own free limit). batch: stories per request. perRun: most stories summarized in one run (every 30 minutes).
